publication.verification: Filter the git ls-tree -r -z records for the implementation SHA and report commit by excludedReportPaths; the resulting ordered records must be identical and hash to nonReportTrackedTreeSha256.
publication.hashMethod: SHA-256 of NUL-delimited git ls-tree -r -z records, with one terminal NUL, after excluding exactly excludedReportPaths.

confirmedRootCauses: Serializable payment-consumer snapshots could remain stale while waiting on the shared immutable intent lock, causing duplicate canonical receipt creation and P2034/P2002 contention.
Provider identity/replay comparisons did not consistently bind every persisted authority field and actor; signed provider transaction identity also needed independent matching.
Downstream hooks could swallow durable dispatch/finalization failures, and some cancellation paths lacked exact reservation-backed stock restoration.
Guest refund journal authority allowed the dedicated original-method liability path only after a narrowly payment-bound forward migration while retaining customer/wallet restrictions.
Support role defaults could bypass an explicit store permission DENY; stateful preview routing could inherit production-backed runtime configuration.
The legacy migration-upgrade helper accepted inherited connection authority, and real browser fixtures hit suite isolation/viewport issues.
principalSafeguards: READ COMMITTED transaction after the existing row lock, seven persisted identity/opId checks, immutable receipt generation fencing, and safe unique-conflict validation.
AsyncLocalStorage transaction context for finalization/review/acknowledgement/settlement, with bounded existing lease/transaction behavior.
Bounded retry only for safe database work; non-idempotent provider actions remain outside retrying transactions; durable failure propagates into reconciliation.
Verified transaction-ID/reference/amount/currency/status binding; duplicate replay checks persisted identity and actor.
Dedicated ORIGINAL_PAYMENT_METHOD guest liability accepts only a successful paid guest marketplace intent with matching verified signed/applied provider evidence and balanced capture.
Exact reservation-source restoration, permission DENY precedence, production-only stateful proxy authority, and owned disposable migration servers/databases/roles.
Linux Chromium measured and fixed native file-input overflow at 390px; original browser assertions and all selected viewport journeys remain unchanged.
